parsed.title: SCENT OF PREY
parsed.body:
All [intruder] in each [corridorNWSE] move.
Then, all [intruder] in every Room move.

Resolve each [ICON: yellow triangular striped glyph with central black wedge and dot] adjacent to a [character].

Each [character] makes a Noise roll.
confidentlyVisible: White uppercase title at the top reads “SCENT OF PREY”.
Central artwork depicts a small suited human figure approaching through an intense red-lit passage.
Two curled white exoskeleton glyphs match the canonical intruder icon.
The white outlined corridor glyph has a northwest-to-southeast long axis.
Two white astronaut glyphs match the canonical character icon.
Rules text is divided into three framed panels.
All meaningful typography is upright and fully visible.
uncertainties: The yellow triangular striped glyph is not confidently matched to any supplied canonical icon and is therefore transcribed literally.
Horizontal bands overlay portions of the artwork; whether they are intentional visual design or a source-art artifact is uncertain.
